definitions.gloss: monthly period, span of a month, month-long (campaign or event)
definitions.explanation: A period spanning one month. Often used as a suffix attached to a campaign or awareness theme to indicate a designated month — similar to English constructions like 'Fire Prevention Month' or 'Breast Cancer Awareness Month.'

examples.japanese: ⟦{交通|こうつう}{安全|あんぜん}→交通安全：22217_koutsuuanzen⟧{月間|げっかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
{月間|げっかん}⟦{売上|うりあげ}→売上：04102_uriage⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{過去|かこ}→過去：00152_kako⟧⟦{最高|さいこう}→最高：02637_saikou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記録|きろく}した→記録する：25341_kirokusuru⟧。
examples.english: Monthly sales set an all-time record.

examples.japanese: ⟦{十月|じゅうがつ}→十月：00634_juugatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{読書|どくしょ}→読書：03484_dokusho⟧⟦{推進|すいしん}→推進：12908_suishin⟧{月間|げっかん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{図書館|としょかん}→図書館：00580_toshokan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{様々|さまざま}→様々：01559_samazama⟧な⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれる→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: October is Reading Promotion Month, and various events are held at libraries.

notes:
USAGE:
{月間|げっかん} has two main uses:
1. As a suffix for designated awareness/campaign months: 〜{月間|げっかん}
2. As a modifier meaning "monthly" or "for the month": {月間|げっかん} + noun

Common designated months in Japan include ⟦{防災|ぼうさい}→防災：07907_bousai⟧{月間|げっかん} (Disaster Prevention Month) and ⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧{月間|げっかん} (Environment Month).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{交通|こうつう}{安全|あんぜん}→交通安全：22217_koutsuuanzen⟧{月間|げっかん}: Traffic Safety Month
- ⟦{防災|ぼうさい}→防災：07907_bousai⟧{月間|げっかん}: Disaster Prevention Month
- {月間|げっかん}⟦{売上|うりあげ}→売上：04102_uriage⟧: monthly sales
- {月間|げっかん}⟦アクセス→アクセス：10696_akusesu⟧⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧: monthly page views
